evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: A labeled 99.86% value must appear on or for the Sun's mass-share mark.
If a normalized whole is used, the Sun segment must either be labeled 0.9986 or visually fill 99.86% of the whole.
The chart or annotation must show a tiny non-Sun remainder labeled 0.14% or explicitly identify it as all remaining objects.

evidence.route_note: geometry requires the two marks to share a zero baseline; a truncated axis fails geometry but may still pass by label
evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: A Sun segment must be visibly contrasted against a much smaller non-Sun segment, not just shown as a standalone 99.86% label.

evidence.route_note: geometry requires the two marks to share a zero baseline; a truncated axis fails geometry but may still pass by label
evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: If included, a comparison annotation or scale must display the ~713x ratio; otherwise this unit is optional and should not be required.
